mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 is interpreted as stable economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as INDPRO has been above 100 for an extended period.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising (3-month change > 0) and the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, the market anticipates further monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in instances where CPIAUCSL 3mo change > 0 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 235), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of sustained low interest rates and stable inflation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods meeting the regime condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 235) (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 units signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 5% indicates a tight labor market and strong economic conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 235 indicates low inflation, which is interpreted as a stable economic environment supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL < 235 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor force employment level (PAYEMS) above 140000 thousand persons indicates robust job growth and economic strength, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 140000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
